name: Project Review - Unlocked Status
description: The internal status-and-decisions page past its passphrase, which this scenario types rather than bypasses. It now opens with an "Also under review" section linking the supporter-network directions deck, so one internal link reaches everything under review instead of raw URLs pasted into separate emails. The deck link is relative rather than root-absolute: both tracks deploy under a base path, and a raw public/ file cannot read Astro's BASE_URL, so /donor-network.html would 404 on the real deploy.
